title: U.S. midterm elections risk Solana: Will 5% SOL ETF outflows create more losses?
summary: U.S. investors could remain critical to SOL’s performance, as historical patterns, capital outflows, and declining network activity pose major risks.
content: U.S. midterm elections pose potential risks for SOL, raising questions about whether potential 5% ETF outflows could trigger further losses. Historical patterns, ongoing capital outflows, and declining network activity indicate that United States investors remain critical to the performance of SOL, creating major headwinds for the digital asset in the near term.
content_ta: அமெரிக்க இடைக்கால தேர்தல்கள் SOL-க்கு சாத்தியமான ஆபத்துகளை ஏற்படுத்துகின்றன, மேலும் 5% ETF வெளியீடுகள் கூடுதல் இழப்புகளை ஏற்படுத்துமா என்ற கேள்விகளை எழுப்புகின்றன. வரலாற்று முறைகள், மூலதன வெளிப்பாடுகள் மற்றும் குறைந்துவரும் நெட்வொர்க் செயல்பாடு ஆகியவை அமெரிக்க முதலீட்டாளர்கள் SOL-ன் செயல்திறனுக்கு முக்கியமானவர்களாக தொடர்கிறார்கள் என்பதைக் காட்டுகின்றன, இது இந்த டிஜிட்டல் சொத்திற்கு பெரிய சவால்களை உருவாக்குகிறது.

content: Mastercard has announced strategic partnerships with OpenAI and Tencent to drive the future of agentic commerce. The collaboration focuses on payments, joint services growth, and AI transformation. According to the company, the agreement includes the integration of Mastercard Agent Pay and extends well beyond standard technological cooperation to shape digital transactions.

Mastercard Agent Pay போன்ற சேவைகளை இணைப்பதுடன், எதிர்கால டிஜிட்டல் பரிவர்த்தனைகளை வடிவமைக்கவும் இந்த ஒப்பந்தம் உதவும்.

title: South Korea urges exchanges to boost cold storage after Binance hack
summary: South Korean crypto exchanges are already required to hold at least 80% of customer crypto in cold wallets, but the regulator is urging more.
content: Following a hack on Binance, South Korean regulators are urging local cryptocurrency exchanges to increase their cold storage holdings. Although exchanges in the country are currently mandated to keep at least 80 percent of customer digital assets in offline cold wallets, authorities are pushing for even higher security measures to better protect user funds from potential future cyber attacks.
content_ta: Binance-ல் நடந்த ஹேக்கிங் சம்பவத்தைத் தொடர்ந்து, சவுத் கொரியா நாட்டு ஒழுங்குமுறை ஆணையங்கள் தங்கள் நாட்டில் உள்ள கிரிப்டோகரன்சி எக்ஸ்சேஞ்சுகளை கோல்டு ஸ்டோரேஜ் அளவை அதிகரிக்க வலியுறுத்துகின்றன. நாட்டில் உள்ள எக்ஸ்சேஞ்சுகள் ஏற்கனவே குறைந்தது 80 சதவீத வாடிக்கையாளர் கிரிப்டோவை கோல்டு வாலட்களில் வைத்திருக்க வேண்டியது கட்டாயமாக்கப்பட்டுள்ள நிலையில், இன்னும் கூடுதலான பாதுகாப்பை உறுதி செய்ய அதிகாரிகள் வலியுறுத்தி வருகின்றனர்.

title: Binance can cut a winning Bitcoin hedge even when customer assets are backed
summary:
Binance says only surplus futures reserves were reallocated, while ADL rules can still reduce an opposing profitable position.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: Binance clarified that only surplus futures reserves were reallocated, emphasizing that automated deleveraging rules can still reduce opposing profitable positions even when customer assets are fully backed. The exchange defended its risk management and hedging practices amid ongoing discussions regarding reserve management in the cryptocurrency market.
content_ta: Binance-ன் உபரி ஃபியூச்சர்ஸ் ரிசர்வ் மட்டுமே மறுஒதுக்கீடு செய்யப்பட்டதாக தெரிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. வாடிக்கையாளர்களின் சொத்துக்கள் முழுமையாக ஆதரிக்கப்பட்டாலும், ஆட்டோமேட்டட் டிஎவரேஜிங் விதிகள் மூலம் லாபகரமான பொசிஷன்களைக் குறைக்க முடியும் என்று Binance விளக்கமளித்துள்ளது.

title: SAT Japan Adds USDT and USDC Payments With Dollar Settlement Through Triple-A
summary: SAT Japan’s Triple-A partnership lets eligible overseas vehicle buyers pay in stablecoins while the exporter receives US dollars.
content: SAT Japan has partnered with Triple-A to enable overseas vehicle buyers to make payments using stablecoins such as USDT and USDC. Through this integration, eligible international customers can settle transactions in digital currencies, while the Japanese vehicle exporter receives the payments in US dollars, streamlining cross-border payments for automotive trade.
content_ta: SAT Japan நிறுவனம் Triple-A உடன் இணைந்து வெளிநாட்டு வாகன வாங்குபவர்கள் USDT மற்றும் USDC போன்ற stablecoin-கள் மூலம் பணம் செலுத்த வழிவகை செய்துள்ளது. இந்த புதிய வசதியின் மூலம் தகுதியான வெளிநாட்டு வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் டிஜிட்டல் கரன்சிகளில் பணம் செலுத்தலாம், அதேசமயம் வாகன ஏற்றுமதியாளர் அந்தப் பணத்தை US dollars-களில் பெற்றுக்கொள்வார்.

title: Ripple and Water.org Expand Stablecoin Work as Aid Payments Move Faster
summary: Ripple and Water.org are expanding payments, RLUSD and custody work, with the central test being how efficiently funding reaches local lenders.
content: Ripple and Water.org are expanding their collaboration involving stablecoins and custody solutions to speed up aid payments. The primary focus of this initiative is testing how efficiently funds can reach local lenders to ensure faster and more effective financial support for communities in need.
content_ta: Ripple மற்றும் Water.org நிறுவனங்கள் உதவிப் பணப் பரிமாற்றங்களை விரைவுபடுத்துவதற்காக ஸ்டேபிள்காயின்கள் மற்றும் கஸ்டடி சேவைகள் தொடர்பான தங்கள் கூட்டாண்மையை விரிவுபடுத்தியுள்ளன. தேவைப்படும் சமூகங்களுக்கு நிதி உதவி மிகவும் திறம்பட சென்றடைவதை உறுதி செய்வதே இந்த முயற்சியின் முக்கிய நோக்கமாகும்.

title: 984M BEAM stolen, then burned – The move that turned a hack into a pump
summary: The attacker never got to sell a single token. But supply-shock rallies are historically short-lived, and BEAM is no exception.
content: An attacker stole 984 million BEAM tokens and subsequently burned them, preventing the sale of a single token. This unusual move created a dramatic supply-shock rally in the market. However, historical trends suggest that such rapid price surges driven by supply shocks are typically short-lived, and BEAM is expected to follow this pattern.
content_ta: ஒரு தாக்குதல் நடத்துபவர் 984 மில்லியன் BEAM டோக்கன்களைத் திருடி, பின்னர் அவற்றை எரித்தார், இதனால் ஒரு டோக்கனைக் கூட விற்க முடியவில்லை. இந்த அசாதாரண நடவடிக்கை சந்தையில் ஒரு வியத்தகு சப்ளை-ஷாக் உயர்வை ஏற்படுத்தியது. இருப்பினும், சப்ளை ஷாக் காரணமாக ஏற்படும் இதுபோன்ற விரைவான விலை உயர்வுகாலம் பொதுவாக குறுகிய காலம் மட்டுமே நீடிக்கும் என்று வரலாற்று போக்குகள் கூறுகின்றன, மேலும் BEAM இந்த முறையைப் பின்பற்றும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

This adjustment suggests that investors are becoming more cautious and reducing their capital allocations as major listings approach, raising questions about broader investor confidence in the sector.
content_ta: செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு சந்தை தொடர்பான கவலைகள் இப்போது தனிப்பட்ட முதலீட்டு சந்தைகளுக்கும் பரவி வருவதாகத் தெரிகிறது. content_ta: Uniswap போன்ற governance token-களின் open governance token வாக்குகள் மத்திய கட்டுப்பாட்டைக் கொண்டவை அல்ல என்று SEC அதிகாரிகள் தெரிவித்துள்ளனர். இதனால் இவற்றுக்கான ஒழுங்குமுறை எளிதாகலாம். எனினும், சில திட்டங்கள் இத்தேர்வில் தோல்வியடைவதால், பல cryptocurrency governance மாதிரிகள் மீது ஒழுங்குமுறைச் சோதனைகள் தொடர்ந்து நீடிக்கின்றன.

content_ta: ஸ்னாப்ஷாட் தரவுகளின்படி, Kinetic-ன் XRP-இணைக்கப்பட்ட கடன் சந்தை வெகுமதிகளுக்கு முன்பு 0.04% அடிப்படை விகிதத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளதாக சமீபத்தில் தெரிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. பிணைய பயன்பாடு மற்றும் ஊக்கத்தொகை ஆதரவு வருமானங்களுடன் ஒப்பிடும்போது, FXRP-க்கான கடன் தேவையை இந்த தளத்தின் புள்ளிவிவரங்கள் எடுத்துக்காட்டுகின்றன.

title: Yardeni Says Analysts Still See S&P 500 Earnings Near $500 Per Share by 2028

content_ta: செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு வளர்ச்சியின் பெருமளவிலான முதலீட்டுத் தேவைகள் காரணமாக, எதிர்காலத்தில் மிகப் பெரிய நிதி திரட்டும் முயற்சிகள் தேவைப்படும் என்று Blackstone-ன் தலைவர் Jon Gray தெரிவித்துள்ளார். செலவுகள் தொடர்ந்து அதிகரித்து வருவதால், நிதிபெறுவதற்கான கடுமையான போட்டி தொழில்நுட்பத் துறை உத்திகளைப் பாதிக்கும் என்றும், பரந்த முதலீட்டுச் சூழலை மாற்றியமைக்கும் என்றும் Crypto Briefing செய்திகள் தெரிவிக்கின்றன.

summary:

content: China's financial regulators have warned that the massive surge in artificial intelligence investments is crowding out traditional industries. Officials noted that this capital concentration risks destabilizing established economic sectors, potentially driving up borrowing costs and increasing credit risks. This growing imbalance highlights the urgent need for careful regulatory oversight to protect the broader economy from potential financial instability.
content_ta: செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு (AI) முதலீடுகளில் ஏற்பட்டுள்ள திடீர் எழுச்சி பாரம்பரிய தொழில்களை பின்னுக்குத் தள்ளுவதாக China-வின் ஒழுங்குமுறை அதிகாரிகள் எச்சரித்துள்ளனர். இந்த மூலதனக் குவிப்பு பொருளாதாரத்தின் நிலைத்தன்மையை பாதிக்கலாம் என்றும், கடன் வாங்கும் செலவுகள் மற்றும் கடன் ஆபத்துக்களை அதிகரிக்கக்கூடும் என்றும் அவர்கள் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளனர்.

title: Arbitrum’s council moved $30 million of Binance hack funds without the hacker’s key
summary: A 12-person committee briefly rewrote one of Arbitrum’s core contracts to spend from an address it held no key for, then put the code back. It’s the second time this year.
content: Arbitrum’s 12-person council temporarily rewrote a core contract to move $30 million in funds connected to a Binance hack, achieving the transfer without possessing the hacker’s private key. The committee restored the original code immediately after the transaction. This marks the second time this year that the governing body has taken such direct intervention to manage compromised funds on the network.
content_ta: Arbitrum-ன் 12 பேர் கொண்ட குழு, Binance ஹேக் சம்பவத்துடன் தொடர்புடைய 30 மில்லியன் டாலர் தொகையை நகர்த்துவதற்காக அதன் முக்கிய ஒப்பந்தத்தை தற்காலிகமாக மாற்றியமைத்தது. ஹேக்கரின் தனிப்பட்ட சாவியின்றி இந்த பரிமாற்றம் மேற்கொள்ளப்பட்டது. பரிமாற்றம் முடிந்ததும் அக்குழு உடனடியாக பழைய குறியீட்டையே மீண்டும் நடைமுறைப்படுத்தியது. இந்த ஆண்டில் நெட்வொர்க்கில் உள்ள முடக்கப்பட்ட நிதியை நிர்வகிக்க இதுபோன்ற நேரடி நடவடிக்கையை இந்த ஆளும் குழு மேற்கொள்வது இது இரண்டாவது முறையாகும்.

title: Bitcoin drops below $77,000 as chip rout deepens ahead of U.S. midterm vote
summary: ZEC tumbled nearly 10% and BNB fell under $700 as the Nasdaq 100 slid into a correction, dragging Asian stocks lower.
content: Bitcoin dropped below $77,000 as a broader chip rout deepened ahead of the U.S. midterm vote. Meanwhile, ZEC tumbled nearly 10% and BNB fell under $700. The declines came as the Nasdaq 100 slid into a correction, dragging Asian stocks lower across the region.
content_ta: அமெரிக்காவின் இடைக்காலத் தேர்தலுக்கு முன்னதாக சிப் பங்குகளின் சரிவு தீவிரமடைந்ததால், Bitcoin விலை $77,000-க்கு கீழே சரிந்தது. இதற்கிடையில், Nasdaq 100 குறியீடு திருத்த நிலைக்குச் சென்றதால், ஆசிய பங்குகளும் சரிவைச் சந்தித்தன; இதனால் ZEC கிட்டத்தட்ட 10% சரிந்தது மற்றும் BNB விலை $700-க்கு கீழே சென்றது.

title: Aave Horizon taps perpetual futures to price stock collateral on weekends, Chainlink says
summary:
The moving reference can reveal off-hours collateral declines without ensuring a buyer for seized assets.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: Chainlink announced that Aave Horizon is using perpetual futures to price stock collateral during weekends. This moving reference mechanism helps track off-hours collateral declines, though it does not guarantee a buyer for any seized assets.
content_ta: வார இறுதி நாட்களில் ஸ்டாக் கொலாடரலை விலை நிர்ணயம் செய்ய perpetual futures-ஐ Aave Horizon பயன்படுத்துவதாக Chainlink தெரிவித்துள்ளது. இந்த நகரும் குறிப்பு முறை வேலை நேரம் அல்லாத நேரங்களில் கொலாடரல் மதிப்பிழப்பைக் கண்காணிக்க உதவுகிறது, இருப்பினும் இது பறிமுதல் செய்யப்பட்ட சொத்துக்களுக்கு வாங்குபவரை உறுதி செய்யாது.

title: RUNE sees major sell-offs after FBI’s demand to block Binance hacker transactions sparks debate

content: RUNE experienced significant sell-offs following the FBI's demand for THORChain node operators to block transactions linked to the Binance hacker. content_ta: FBI விடுத்த கோரிக்கையைத் தொடர்ந்து RUNE விலையில் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க சரிவு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது. Binance ஹேக்கருடன் தொடர்புடைய பரிவர்த்தனைகளைத் தடுக்குமாறு THORChain நோட் இயக்கிகளை FBI கேட்டுக் கொண்டது. இந்த கோரிக்கை கிரிப்டோகரன்சி சமூகத்தில் பரவலான விவாதத்தை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: Nvidia tells cloud clients to sell at least 51% of services to non-Chinese firms

content_ta: Nvidia தனது கிளவுட் கம்ப்யூட்டிங் வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் தங்கள் சேவைகளில் பெரும்பகுதியை சீனா அல்லாத நிறுவனங்களுக்கு மட்டுமே விற்க வேண்டும் என்று அறிவுறுத்தியுள்ளதாக தகவல்கள் வெளியாகியுள்ளன. இந்த நடவடிக்கை உலகளாவிய கிளவுட் சேவை சந்தையில் மாற்றங்களை ஏற்படுத்தக்கூடும்.

content_ta: Ethereum Foundation பிளாக் வரம்புகளைச் சரிபார்க்கும் நோக்கில் evm.fast சவாலைத் தொடங்கியுள்ளது. இந்த முயற்சியானது யூகிக்கக்கூடிய சரிபார்ப்புச் செலவுகளை உறுதி செய்வதையும், பாதுகாப்பு அபாயங்களைக் குறைப்பதையும் நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது. இதன் மூலம் Ethereum நெட்வொர்க்கின் பாதுகாப்பு மற்றும் செயல்திறனை மேலும் மேம்படுத்த முடியும்.

title: Finmo Launches Business Account for Cross-Border SMEs, Adding Licensed Multi-Currency Money Movement to Finmo Treasury
summary:
Finmo, the treasury operating system for global businesses, today announced the launch of the Finmo Business Account, a multi-currency account for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) that operate across borders. Businesses receive local account details in their own name to collect funds in more than 45 currencies, hold more than 27 currencies and make payments to more than 195 countries and territories. Finmo provides every collection, conversion and payment directly, under its own licences and through its payments partner network. 
The Business Account also extends Finmo Treasury. Treasury users already see their cash position and forecasts across every entity and bank. Now they can also move funds in multiple currencies in real time, from the same platform. 
SMEs that transact internationally often hold accounts with several providers. They decide whether to convert, hold or pay with only part of the picture. Many keep larger idle balances than they need, or convert funds they later need back. 
"Businesses have usually had to choose between a provider that moves their money and software that shows them where it is," said David Hanna, Co-Founder and CEO of Finmo. "Because Finmo holds the licences and partnerships to move money itself, the Business Account closes that gap. A company can see its position and act on it in one place, on infrastructure we operate." 
What the Business Account offers SMEs 
● Get paid like a local: local account details in the company’s own name, so customers pay in their own currency. 
● Convert on your terms: no forced conversion. Businesses convert only when they choose. 
● See the cost first: fees and exchange rates are shown before every conversion and payment. 
● Pay globally: bulk payouts, bill payments and scheduled transfers. ● Keep the books in sync: transactions synchronise with leading ERP and accounting platforms. 
● Put surplus cash to work: money market funds. 
● Built for teams: unlimited users, with approvals for the people who move money. 
Licensed money movement, operated by Finmo 
Finmo is the licensed provider behind the Business Account; the account doesn’t run on another company’s platform. Finmo holds 11 licences and regulatory permissions across eight markets, including a Major Payment Institution licence from the Monetary Authority of Singapore. Businesses move more than US$1 billion through Finmo every month. 
A module within Finmo Treasury 
For businesses that also use Finmo Treasury, the Business Account works seamlessly across the platform. Finmo Treasury consolidates balances across a company's entities and its accounts at other banks into a single cash position, provides a 13-week cash flow forecast, and monitors cash balances to proactively manage counterparty exposure, FX risk,
and minimum balances. With the Business Account in the same platform, a finance team that spots idle cash, a funding gap or a currency it should convert can carry out the conversion or payment without leaving Finmo. MO AI, Finmo’s built-in AI agent, is rapidly evolving to bring greater intelligence, decision-making, and execution to users. 
“Treasury platforms have long been good at showing companies their cash, but they have depended on banks to act on it,” Hanna added. “We spent years securing licences across eight markets so Finmo could do both. With the Business Account, licensed money movement now sits inside a treasury platform, and that is central to where we are taking the company.” 
Availability 
Global businesses can apply online for a Finmo Business Account. Singapore-incorporated companies can apply online through MyInfo Business using Corppass and Singpass. 
To mark the launch, new customers who register here with the code FINMOBA26 can receive up to US $100 in cashback. Terms and conditions apply. 
Finmo will demonstrate the Finmo Business Account and Finmo Treasury at Singapore FinTech Festival 2026, 18 to 20 November, at booth 3L19 in Hall 3. 
 
NoYesPayments03 Nov, 2026
content: Finmo has launched the Finmo Business Account, a multi-currency account designed for cross-border SMEs. The new offering allows businesses to collect, hold, and convert multiple currencies while making global payments. Integrated directly into Finmo Treasury, the account bridges the gap between financial visibility and money movement. Operating under its own regulatory licences across multiple markets, Finmo aims to simplify international transactions and cash management for global enterprises.

title: Ant International Explores the Future of Personalised, Privacy-First AI Experiences
summary:
Human sales and customer representatives have institutional memories to serve clients: their preferences and choices. How can we build a memory mechanism for AI services to create similarly personalised experiences?
Ant International’s research on this subject recently received the Senior Area Chair (SAC) Highlight Award from the Best Paper Committee at EMNLP 2026, a leading global AI conference.
Why do we need “readable AI memory”?
In this paper titled 'Text as a universal interface for transferable personalisation', we look into one fact: until now, AI memory of a user has usually been generated and stored as dense numerical code only the original system can interpret.
Two long-standing problems with that: First, today's user profiles are "black boxes" — opaque code locked inside a single app, so activity in one service teaches nothing to another, and every product has to re-learn you from scratch.
Second, profiles are welded to the model that created them, so they don't transfer when products or models change.
How do we create “readable AI memory”?
Our approach treats natural language as a universal interface: the preference summary is plain text, so any model or service can read, audit and act on it.
Training a model to write good preference summaries is the key here. To make those summaries genuinely accurate, we trained the model in two stages. First, generating candidate profiles and stress-testing them against users' actual future choices, keeping only those that prove correct. Second, reinforcing summaries that stay useful as they're updated over time.
We developed AlignXplore+, a universal preference reasoning model, which is trained to log a user’s preferences through short, plain-language summaries, continuously updated as new interactions happen, or a “readable AI memory”.
What does this research mean for AI and fintech?
This research shows that these preference summaries can transfer across different tasks and models effectively. Moreover, at 8bn parameters, our model is relatively compact, but achieved an average score of 75.10% across nine benchmarks – a significant advantage over an open-source model more than twice its size. This shows that the quality of the representation (how well the summaries are constructed) matters more than the size of the model.
The findings also present several practical upsides for data privacy, fairness and consumer trust.
With a universal data interface, personalisation no longer depends on collecting or moving raw behavioural data between systems, and only the distilled, readable summary travels. That supports personalisation across an ecosystem, from payments to mini-programmes to merchant platforms, in a privacy-considerate way. Because the profile is expressed as text, it can also be audited, explained and corrected, which makes it more transparent and trustable.
Second, it means smaller, more efficient models can deliver excellent personalisation when paired with a strong memory, rather than relying on the largest possible model. That has real implications for cost and speed for businesses.
What are some practical applications of these insights?
First, a merchant or wallet could offer genuinely seamless, personalised experiences across every touchpoint — recommendations, product offers, an AI assistant — driven by one coherent, portable view of the customer.
Second, a readable preference profile supports explainability and governance, because humans can review and edit it.
Third, it offers a more efficient route to personalisation on smaller models, which matters for latency and operating cost at scale.
Imagine you’re planning a trip. Today, even with AI assistants, that may involve explaining your needs and preferences repeatedly to different platforms for flights, hotels and tours.
A readable and secure AI memory of you simplifies and connects these needs. Booking flights and hotels? Your AI assistant logs your preferences in plain language — "prefers window seats, is a member of these frequent flyer programs, prefers hotels within 40 minutes ride to the airport." As the journey progresses, this readable profile updates automatically.
When you hail a ride via another app, ride types, promotions and AI’s suggestions pop up tailored to your preferences, even though the profile was built in a different service by a different model. No behavioural data was shipped around, and no giant models required. The consumer simply feels understood from the first tap across connected services.
All in all, a transferrable, secure AI memory mechanism provides richer, more trusted and more inclusive experiences for consumers.

The study introduces a method using natural language as a universal interface for transferable personalisation, allowing user preferences to be stored as plain text. title: Zip Research Reveals 83% of U.S. BNPL Users With a Preferred Provider Would Likely Abandon a Purchase Without It
summary:
Zip, the digital financial services company offering innovative, people-centered products, today released new research showing that payment preferences are shaping where consumers shop. Among surveyed U.S. buy now, pay later (BNPL) users, 83% say they would be likely to abandon a purchase if their preferred BNPL provider weren’t available at checkout.
Among those shoppers, 46% say they have already abandoned a purchase in the past 12 months because their preferred provider wasn’t available. Of those who abandoned a purchase, 39% went on to buy from a different retailer, and 75% of abandoned carts with a reported value were worth $100 or more.
“Payment choice isn’t just a checkout feature, it shapes where consumers choose to shop. These findings reinforce the importance of giving customers access to financial tools they know and trust. For retailers, offering the right payment options means creating better shopping experiences and reducing the risk of losing customers at checkout,” said Rory Herriman, President and Interim CEO, Zip US.
Additional findings highlight the role of BNPL throughout the shopping journey:
65% of shoppers with a preferred provider say it is extremely or very important that a retailer offers it.
59% of shoppers with a preferred provider say they have chosen one retailer over another because it offered their preferred BNPL, and 90% of those shoppers say they would likely abandon a purchase without it.
73% of all surveyed BNPL users say they consider BNPL before they reach checkout.
62% of all surveyed BNPL users say they have used BNPL for a purchase they otherwise would have postponed or skipped.
The findings reflect Zip’s commitment to putting customers first by offering flexible, transparent payment options that support greater control and confidence in their financial decisions, while helping merchants better serve the shoppers they want to keep.
What merchants can do with these findings:
With the holiday shopping season approaching, Zip encourages merchants to consider three steps to keep shoppers who plan on using BNPL:
Show BNPL options early, not just at checkout. 73% of surveyed BNPL users consider BNPL before reaching the cart.
Make preferred providers visible. 65% of shoppers with a preferred provider say it is extremely or very important that a retailer offers it.
Keep checkout simple. An easy-to-use app and an easy checkout experience are among the top reasons shoppers with a preferred provider choose their BNPL.

title: American Express, NBA and WNBA Expand Longstanding Partnership Globally
summary:
The National Basketball Association (NBA), Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and American Express (NYSE: AXP) today announced the global expansion of their partnership, building on their decades-long relationship and American Express' role as the Official Payments Partner of the NBA and WNBA to bring more access, experiences and value to American Express Card Members and NBA fans around the world. The expansion marks the first season of international activations across the NBA, WNBA and USA Basketball under the multiyear partnership, which also includes the NBA G League and NBA Take-Two Media, building on the breadth of American Express' global sports partnerships across leagues, teams, events and venues.
American Express will serve as Presenting Partner of select NBA Houses, extending its international presence and bringing immersive NBA experiences to fans around the world. Held in conjunction with marquee NBA moments, NBA Houses feature viewing parties, experiential activations, meet-and-greets with NBA players and legends, official NBA merchandise and more.
American Express will also serve as an Associate Partner of select NBA Global Games, including three sold-out games this season: The NBA Mexico City Game 2026 presented by Michelob Ultra between the Denver Nuggets and Indiana Pacers on Nov. 7; The NBA Paris Game 2027 presented by Tissot on Jan. 14; and The NBA Manchester Game 2027 on Jan. 17, with the New Orleans Pelicans and San Antonio Spurs facing off in both European games. American Express will continue as Entitlement Partner of NBA Tip-Off and maintains relationships with the Brooklyn Nets, Chicago Bulls, Utah Jazz, and New York Liberty.
“Sports have a unique power to bring people together, and basketball’s international appeal is no exception,” said Elizabeth Rutledge, Chief Marketing Officer, American Express. “As we expand our global sports partnerships, we’re creating more ways for Card Members to experience what they love. Expanding our longstanding NBA and WNBA partnerships marks an exciting next chapter, bringing Card Members and fans around the world closer to the game and the moments that matter most.”
“We’re thrilled to build upon the longstanding partnership success we’ve had with American Express and now deliver programs and activations to fans around the world,” said Kerry Tatlock, EVP Global Marketing Partnerships and Media, NBA. “The continued growth of basketball globally creates tremendous opportunities to further deliver on our shared commitment to engage fans in new and meaningful ways.”
WNBA and USA Basketball Collaboration
Under the renewed agreement, American Express is deepening its presence with the WNBA and beginning a new partnership with USA Basketball in the U.S. and globally. American Express serves as an Associate Partner of the USA Basketball Showcase and 3x3 National Teams, offering Card Members access to purchase Amex Presale Tickets® to the USA Basketball Showcase and a customized Premium Events Collection™ program for eligible Card Members during the USA Basketball Showcase, a series of exhibition games held prior to major international competitions, and other national team activity.
American Express also continues to build on its longstanding relationship with the WNBA by providing Card Members with access to purchase tickets to select league events and experiences, including the AT&T WNBA All-Star Game, while helping bring fans closer to the game through unique programming and engagement opportunities.

title: Bank of America Expands Cross-Border Real-Time Payments to Meet Growing Client Demand
summary:
At Money20/20 USA, Financial IT spoke with Daniel Stanton, Managing Director and Global Head of Transactional FX, Cross-Border Real-Time Payments and Clearing at Bank of America, about the bank’s cross-border real-time payments solution, its successful pilot transaction with Bradesco, and plans to expand the service to more than 40 currencies across 70 countries.
Bradesco’s first pilot transaction demonstrated the potential of Bank of America’s Cross-Border Real-Time Payments solution. Can you tell us more about this milestone and why it matters?
The Bradesco transaction demonstrated that we can move value across borders in seconds. We were able to debit Bradesco’s account with Bank of America and pay a beneficiary in Hong Kong in less than a minute, using existing capabilities and technology.
We believe this is exactly what our clients are looking for. From an implementation perspective, the solution is designed to minimise disruption and limit technology investment on the client side. This allows us to connect seamlessly with our clients while enabling them to expand their capabilities and enhance their own customer propositions without placing additional strain on their technology infrastructure.
What is driving growing demand among financial institutions for faster and more transparent cross-border payments?
Ultimately, demand is being driven by our clients and the evolving expectations of their customers. They want certainty and greater control over when a beneficiary is paid, as well as transparency throughout the payment lifecycle.
The question has moved beyond simply asking, “When will my payment arrive?” Clients now want to know, “Where is my payment?” They increasingly expect access to self-service tools that allow them to track transactions and obtain updates without having to make enquiries.
Our Cross-Border Real-Time Payments solution addresses these needs by combining speed, transparency and greater certainty over when a beneficiary will receive funds. This enables our financial institution clients to deliver the same benefits to their own customers, giving them greater control over the payment process.
How does Bank of America’s solution enable banks to leverage their existing SWIFT connectivity while accessing real-time payment capabilities?
Our clients can access the solution through their existing SWIFT connection. SWIFT has more than 12,500 member banks worldwide, and Bank of America already provides dollar clearing services to many of these financial institutions.
By building on these established clearing relationships and existing SWIFT connectivity, clients can send us a pacs.008 payment message without needing to establish an entirely new connection. We then route the payment directly into the destination country through the relevant low-value or real-time payments clearing system.
The key is that we are using existing technology and connectivity while enabling real-time delivery for the final leg of the payment journey. This approach allows financial institutions to access cross-border real-time payment capabilities without having to overhaul their existing infrastructure.
What key benefits can financial institutions expect, particularly in terms of payment certainty, tracking and operational efficiency?
Real-time payments bring several important benefits, including speed, transparency, pricing advantages and more efficient reconciliation. Our solution extends these benefits to cross-border transactions.
Clients have greater control over when a beneficiary is paid, whether the payment needs to arrive immediately or at a specified point in the following days. We also provide payment transparency through SWIFT GPI and other tracking tools, allowing clients to see where a transaction is in its lifecycle and share that information with their own customers.
There are also operational benefits. Real-time payment transactions are irrevocable and follow specific routing and formatting requirements, helping to reduce the likelihood of returns and rejected payments. This can minimise manual intervention, reduce the need for investigations and improve overall operational efficiency compared with more traditional payment methods.
Looking ahead, what’s next for Bank of America’s Cross-Border Real-Time Payments solution?
We will continue to expand the solution’s reach and functionality. The capability is currently available in 10 currencies, and we plan to extend it to more than 40 currencies across 70 countries in 2027.
We also intend to make the solution available to a broader range of clients beyond financial institutions. This includes host-to-host connectivity for clients seeking machine-to-machine integration, as well as API connectivity for those looking for more immediate, direct interaction with Bank of America.
Our focus is on expanding access while giving clients greater flexibility in how they integrate cross-border real-time payments into their operations.
Daniel StantonManaging Director and Global Head of Transactional FX, Cross-Border Real-Time Payments and ClearingBank of AmericaYes
content: Bank of America is expanding its cross-border real-time payments solution following a successful pilot transaction with Bradesco. The service enables fast value transfers across borders using existing SWIFT connectivity and infrastructure. Bank of America plans to extend the capability to more than 40 currencies across 70 countries by 2027, meeting growing client demand for speed, transparency, and operational efficiency.
content_ta: Bradesco உடன் வெற்றிகரமான பைலட் பரிவர்த்தனையைத் தொடர்ந்து, Bank of America தனது எல்லை கடந்த உடனடி பணப்பரிவர்த்தனை தீர்வை விரிவுபடுகி றது. தற்போதுள்ள SWIFT இணைப்பு மற்றும் உள்கட்டமைப்பைப் பயன்படுத்தி இந்த சேவை விரைவான பணப் பரிமாற்றங்களை செயல்படுத்துகிறது. வேகம், வெளிப்படைத்தன்மை மற்றும் செயல்பாட்டுத் திறன்ச்சிக்கான வாடிக்கையாளர்களின் வளர்ந்து வரும் தேவைகளைப் பூர்த்தி செய்யும் வகையில், 2027 ஆம் ஆண்டுக்குள் 70 நாடுகளில் 40 க்கும் மேற்பட்ட கரன்சிகளுக்கு இந்த வசதியை விரிவுபடுத்த Bank of America திட்டமிட்டுள்ளது.

title: ETHGas wants to bring Wall Street to public Ethereum by selling advance block reservations
summary: But there’s a catch: validators that fail to deliver on their commitments currently face no financial compensation requirement under the service.
content: ETHGas aims to connect Wall Street with the public Ethereum network by offering advance block reservations. However, the service currently features a notable limitation: validators who fail to fulfill their commitments do not face any financial compensation requirements.
content_ta: Wall Street மற்றும் பப்ளிக் Ethereum நெட்வொர்க்கை இணைக்க முன்கூட்டிய பிளாக் ரிசர்வேஷன் முறையை ETHGas அறிமுகப்படுத்த திட்டமிட்டுள்ளது. இருப்பினும், தங்கள் வாக்குறுதிகளை நிறைவேற்றத் தவறும் வேிடட்டர்களுக்கு தற்போது எந்தவிதமான நிதி இழப்பீட்டு பொறுப்பும் இல்லை என்பது குறிப்பிடத்தக்க குறைபாடாகும்.

title: Bitcoin steadies after dip to $76,300 as ETF outflows and midterm elections weigh on crypto
summary: Bitcoin edged up 0.2% to around $76,900 since midnight UTC as spot ETFs lost $399 million for a second day and Binance customers pulled a net $4.72 billion.
content: Bitcoin stabilized near $76,900 after dipping to $76,300. The leading cryptocurrency faced downward pressure as spot exchange-traded funds experienced significant outflows for a second consecutive day, alongside notable withdrawals from Binance customers. The market is also digesting the broader economic and political context surrounding recent midterm elections.
content_ta: Bitcoin மதிப்பு $76,300 வரை குறைந்த பின்னர் மீண்டு சுமார் $76,900 ஆக நிலைபெற்றது. தொடர்ந்து இரண்டாவது நாளாக spot ETF-களில் இருந்து பெருமளவு முதலீடுகள் வெளியேறியதும், Binance வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் பணத்தை வெளியே எடுத்ததும் கிரிப்டோ சந்தையில் தாக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்தியது. மேலும், இடைக்காலத் தேர்தல்களும் சந்தையில் தாக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளன.

title: Liquid’s bitcoin IOUs are fully backed again after a $320 million exploit
summary: A final 250 BTC transfer closed the hole left by September’s bug, but the federation behind the network still hasn’t said who paid to fill it.
content: Liquid's bitcoin IOUs are fully backed once again following a $320 million exploit. A final transfer of 250 BTC successfully closed the gap left by a September bug. However, the federation operating the network has not yet disclosed the identity of the entity that funded the recovery to fill the deficit.
content_ta: $320 million மதிப்புள்ள exploit-க்குப் பிறகு, Liquid-ன் bitcoin IOUs மீண்டும் முழுமையாக respald செய்யப்பட்டதாக அறிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. செப்டம்பர் மாத bug காரணமாக ஏற்பட்ட இடைவெளியை ஒரு இறுதி 250 BTC பரிமாற்றம் வெற்றிகரமாக மூடியது. இருப்பினும், இந்த இழப்பைச் சரிசெய்ய நிதியளித்த நபர் அல்லது நிறுவனம் பற்றிய விவரங்களை நெட்வொர்க்கை இயக்கும் federation இன்னும் வெளியிடவில்லை.

title: Live news: Bitcoin faces fifth weekly loss as midterm elections weigh on markets
summary: A fifth straight weekly decline would mark bitcoin’s joint third-longest losing streak, as oil rebounds and Apple’s margin warning adds to investor caution ahead of the U.S. midterms.
content: Bitcoin is heading toward its fifth consecutive weekly decline, matching one of its longest losing streaks. Investor caution is mounting ahead of the U.S. midterm elections. Markets are also feeling pressure from a rebound in oil prices and a profit margin warning from Apple, contributing to a broader cautious sentiment among financial market participants.
content_ta: Bitcoin தொடர்ந்து ஐந்தாவது வாரமாக சரிவை சந்தித்து வருகிறது. அமெரிக்காவின் இடைக்கால தேர்தலுக்கு முன்பாக முதலீட்டாளர்களிடையே எச்சரிக்கை உணர்வு அதிகரித்துள்ளது. இதற்கிடையில், எண்ணெய் விலையில் ஏற்பட்டுள்ள மீட்சியும், Apple நிறுவனத்தின் லாட்டுக் விளிம்பு எச்சரிக்கையும் சந்தையில் முதலீட்டாளர்களின் எச்சரிக்கை உணர்வை மேலும் தீவிரப்படுத்தியுள்ளன.

title: France postpones 2027 budget vote, crypto exit-tax proposals scrapped
summary: The National Assembly postponed the vote on the budget’s revenue section for the second time, while the Nov. 17 deadline for the first reading examination nears.
content: France has postponed its budget vote for the second time as the deadline for the first reading examination approaches. Amid these legislative delays, proposals regarding a crypto exit-tax have officially been scrapped. The National Assembly continues to work through the complex fiscal planning as time runs short for the upcoming examination.
content_ta: பிரான்ஸ் தனது பட்ஜெட் வாக்கெடுப்பை இரண்டாவது முறையாக ஒத்திவைத்துள்ளது. முதல் வாசிப்பு பரிசீலனைக்கான காலக்கெடு நெருங்கி வரும் வேளையில் இந்த தாமதம் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த சட்டமன்றத் தாமதங்களுக்கு மத்தியில், crypto exit-tax தொடர்பான முன்மொழிவுகள் அதிகாரப்பூர்வமாக கைவிடப்பட்டுள்ளன. தேசியப் பேரவை வரவிருக்கும் பரிசீலனைக்காக தொடர் பணிகளில் ஈடுபட்டுள்ளது.

title: Bitcoin price threatens $77.7K support loss with recent buyers underwater
summary: Bitcoin fell below the realized price of the one-to-three-month-old buyer cohort in a move that risked flipping it to new resistance.
content: Bitcoin price is facing pressure as it threatens a key support loss at $77.7K. Recent buyers are currently underwater after Bitcoin fell below the realized price of the one-to-three-month-old buyer cohort. This market movement has raised concerns that the former support level could now flip into a new resistance level for the cryptocurrency.
content_ta: Bitcoin விலை $77.7K ஆதரவு நிலையை இழக்கும் அபாயத்தை எதிர்கொண்டுள்ளது. சமீபத்தில் Bitcoin வாங்கியவர்கள் தற்போது நஷ்டத்தில் உள்ளனர். ஒரு முதல் மூன்று மாத கால வாங்குபவர்களின் மெய்யான விலைக்கு கீழே Bitcoin சரிந்ததால், இந்த முந்தைய ஆதரவு நிலை புதிய எதிர்ப்பாக மாறக்கூடும் என்ற அச்சம் எழுந்துள்ளது.

title: Liquid Network Restores Full Bitcoin Backing Two Months After $320M Exploit
summary: Blockstream CEO Adam Back said the sidechain's defenses have been hardened, and warned developers not to trust AI-suggested fixes blindly.
content: Liquid Network has restored full Bitcoin backing two months after suffering a major multimillion-dollar exploit. Blockstream CEO Adam Back announced that the sidechain's security defenses have been successfully hardened. He also cautioned developers against blindly trusting AI-suggested code fixes, emphasizing the importance of thorough security reviews following the incident.
content_ta: மில்லியன் கணக்கான டாலர் மதிப்புள்ள பாதுகாப்புத் தாக்குதலுக்குள்ளாகி இரண்டு மாதங்களுக்குப் பிறகு, Liquid Network தனது முழுமையான Bitcoin பேக்கிங்கை மீட்டுள்ளது. இந்த சைட் செயினின் பாதுகாப்பு முறைப்புகள் பலப்படுத்தப்பட்டுள்ளதாக Blockstream CEO Adam Back அறிவித்துள்ளார். மேலும், இந்தச் சம்பவத்தைத் தொடர்ந்து, AI பரிந்துரைக்கும் குறியீட்டுத் திருத்தங்களை டெவலப்பர்கள் கண்மூடித்தனமாக நம்ப வேண்டாம் என்றும் அவர் எச்சரித்துள்ளார்.

title: Bybit and Bitget see crypto deposits surge following Binance’s $6.3 billion hack
summary:
Bybit and Bitget recorded larger address counts during the shutdown, but the data do not establish Binance customer migration.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: Crypto platforms Bybit and Bitget experienced a surge in deposits and increased address counts following a massive $6.3 billion hack incident involving Binance. However, industry data indicates that while activity on these competing exchanges grew during the period, the figures do not definitively establish whether users from Binance migrated to these alternative platforms.
content_ta: Binance-ஐ பாதித்த $6.3 பில்லியன் ஹேக் சம்பவத்தை தொடர்ந்து, Bybit மற்றும் Bitget போன்ற கிரிப்டோ தளங்களில் டெபாசிட்டுகள் மற்றும் முகவரிகளின் எண்ணிக்கை கணிசமாக அதிகரித்துள்ளன. இருப்பினும், இந்த போட்டி பரிமாற்றங்களில் செயல்பாடு அதிகரித்திருந்தாலும், Binance பயனர்கள் இந்த மாற்று தளங்களுக்கு மாறினார்களா என்பதை தரவுகள் உறுதியாகக் காட்டவில்லை.

title: BTCPay urges Bitcoin merchants to replace wallets after hackers steal an estimated $1.6 million
summary:
The November 2 update links hot-wallet thefts to an August-patched flaw and says updating cannot remove access already gained.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: BTCPay has urged Bitcoin merchants to replace their wallets following a security breach where hackers stole an estimated $1.6 million. The thefts have been linked to a vulnerability previously patched in August. Officials warn that simply updating software cannot remove unauthorized access already gained by attackers, requiring merchants to migrate funds to new wallets immediately.
content_ta: சுமார் $1.6 மில்லியன் மதிப்புள்ள ஃபண்டுகள் ஹேக்கர்களால் திருடப்பட்டதை அடுத்து, தங்கள் வாலெட்டுகளை மாற்றியமைக்குமாறு Bitcoin மெர்ச்சன்ட்களுக்கு BTCPay எச்சரிக்கை விடுத்துள்ளது. ஆகஸ்ட் மாதமே சரிசெய்யப்பட்ட ஒரு பாதுகாப்பு குறைபாட்டுடன் இந்த திருட்டுகள் தொடர்புபடுத்தப்பட்டுள்ளன. ஏற்கனவே ஹேக்கர்களால் பெறப்பட்ட அணுகலை மென்பொருள் அப்டேட் மூலம் நீக்க முடியாது என்பதால், மெர்ச்சன்ட்டுகள் உடனடியாக புதிய வாலெட்டுகளுக்கு மாற வேண்டும் என எச்சரிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளனர்.

title: MEXC Upgrades Futures Earn to Empower Retail Traders With a Clearer, More Intuitive Experience
summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, November 3, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, announced an upgrade to Futures Earn. This product helps retail traders use their capital more efficiently by allowing eligible futures account balances to earn interest while users continue trading. The upgrade is designed to improve the overall user experience and make the product easier to understand and use.   Futures Earn Upgrade Highlights Futures Earn involves several aspects, including interest calculation rules and reward calculation. To help users better understand and navigate Futures Earn throughout their user journey, MEXC has made three key improvements to the user experience. Visualized Reward Rules: The core logic behind reward calculations is now presented through diagrams, making it easier for users to understand how earnings are calculated. Scenario-Based Guidance: Users receive timely, in-context guidance at key stages of the user journey, from activating Futures Earn and depositing funds to earning interest on open positions. Earnings Calculator: Users can customize parameters to estimate potential earnings, making it easier to understand and assess expected returns before using the product.   Innovative Interest Mechanism, Up to 20% APR Futures Earn introduces an innovative way to put trading capital to work, built around the idea that “Your Futures Balance Earns Too.” By integrating an interest-earning mechanism directly into the futures account, it allows eligible balances to automatically generate interest while remaining available for futures trading. Users do not need to choose between trading and earning, transfer funds out of their futures account, or subscribe to a separate earning product.   Dedicated futures earning products remain relatively uncommon across the industry. Among the offerings currently available, some are limited to a single stablecoin, require minimum trading volumes, or operate as time-limited campaigns. MEXC Futures Earn combines broader asset coverage, higher earning potential, and lower barriers to participation. It supports eligible USDT- and USDE-margined futures pairs, with no minimum trading volume requirement or fixed end date. USDT-margined pairs offer a 5% base APR plus up to 15% in additional rewards, bringing the maximum APR to 20%, while USDE-margined pairs offer a 4.75% base APR. title: ZEC and NEAR Tank Again, BTC Dives Ahead of US Midterm Elections: Market Watch
summary: RAIN is among the few alts today to defy the overall market weakness.
content: Cryptocurrencies like ZEC and NEAR experienced another steep decline, while BTC also dropped sharply as markets braced for the upcoming United States midterm elections. Despite the widespread market weakness affecting most digital assets, RAIN managed to defy the downward trend and remained one of the few resilient altcoins.
content_ta: ZEC மற்றும் NEAR போன்ற கிரப்டோகரன்சிகள் மீண்டும் சரிவை சந்தித்தன. அமெரிக்க இடைக்காலத் தேர்தலை முன்னிட்டு சந்தைகள் தயாராகி வருவதால் BTC விலையும் சரிந்தது. பெரும்பான்மையான டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துகளை பாதித்த இந்த சந்தை பலவீனத்திற்கு மத்தியில், RAIN மட்டும் வீழ்ச்சியை எதிர்த்து சிறப்பான மீள்தன்மையை காட்டியது.

title: US Midterms Are Here: History Points to a Stock Rally but Trouble for Bitcoin

content: As the US midterms arrive, historical trends suggest a potential stock rally for the S&P 500 despite ongoing market struggles. However, the outlook appears more challenging for Bitcoin, with indicators pointing toward a potential further price decline as political and economic uncertainties unfold.
content_ta: US midterms தேர்தல்கள் வந்துள்ள நிலையில், தற்போதைய சந்தைச் சிக்கல்கள் இருந்தபோதிலும் S&P 500 குறியீட்டு எண் மீண்டு எழுந்து பங்குச் சந்தையில் ஏற்றம் காண வரலாறு வழிவகை செய்கிறது. அதே நேரத்தில், அரசியல் மற்றும் பொருளாதார நிச்சயமற்ற தன்மைகள் காரணமாக Bitcoin-க்கு மேலும் விலை சரிவு ஏற்படக்கூடும் என அறிகுறிகள் காட்டுகின்றன.

title: Aave drops 6% as whale sells 184,203 tokens – Who absorbs the supply?
summary: Aave announced that USDC incentives were live on its V4 platform on Base, and the rewards make it cheaper to borrow USDC against tokenized stocks.
content: Aave dropped 6% following a large whale sale of 184,203 tokens. Meanwhile, Aave announced that USDC incentives are now live on its V4 platform on Base, making it cheaper to borrow USDC against tokenized stocks. Market participants are watching closely to see who will absorb the heavy token supply.
content_ta: ஒரு பெரிய வேல் 184,203 டோக்கன்களை விற்றதைத் தொடர்ந்து Aave விலை 6% சரிந்தது. இதற்கிடையில், Base-ல் உள்ள தனது V4 மேடையில் USDC ஊக்கத்தொகைகள் தொடங்கப்பட்டுள்ளதாக Aave அறிவித்துள்ளது. இதனால் டோக்கன் செய்யப்பட்ட பங்குகளுக்கு எதிராக USDC கடன் வாங்குவது எளிதாகியுள்ளது. இந்த அதிகப்படியான டோக்கன்供應-ஐ யார் ஏற்றுக்கொள்வார்கள் என்பதை சந்தை பார்வையாளர்கள் கவனித்து வருகின்றனர்.

title: FBI blames North Korea for the $6.3B Binance hack – Kim Yo Jong slams back
summary: North Korea’s denial raises fresh questions about the evidence behind the FBI’s attribution and the recovery of billions in stolen crypto.
content: The FBI has officially blamed North Korea for a massive $6.3 billion Binance hack. In response, high-ranking official Kim Yo Jong sharply denied the allegations, escalating tensions. This public denial by North Korea raises fresh questions regarding the evidence used in the FBI's attribution and the ongoing efforts to recover billions in stolen cryptocurrency.
content_ta: மில்லியன் கணக்கான டாலர் மதிப்புள்ள Binance ஹேக் வழக்கில் North Korea நாட்டை FBI குற்றம் சாட்டியுள்ளது. இதற்கு பதிலளிக்கும் விதமாக, உயர் அதிகாரி Kim Yo Jong இந்தக் குற்றச்சாட்டுகளை கடுமையாக மறுத்துள்ளார். North Korea-வின் இந்த மறுப்பு, FBI-ன் குற்றச்சாட்டுக்கான ஆதாரங்கள் மற்றும் திருடப்பட்ட கிரிப்டோகரன்சியை மீட்கும் முயற்சிகள் குறித்து புதிய கேள்விகளை எழுப்பியுள்ளது.

title: Arbitrum freezes $30M in Binance hack-linked funds as ARB falls 4.5%
summary: ARB's price action was bearish in the short term and could sink to $0.141 and $0.131 in the coming days.
content: Arbitrum has reportedly frozen $30 million in funds linked to the recent Binance hack. Meanwhile, the ARB token experienced a downward price movement, falling by 4.5%. Market analysts indicate that ARB's short-term price action remains bearish, warning that the cryptocurrency could potentially sink further to support levels at $0.141 and $0.131 in the coming days.
content_ta: Binance ஹேக் சம்பவத்துடன் தொடர்புடைய 30 மில்லியன் டாலர் தொகையை Arbitrum முடக்கியுள்ளது. இதற்கிடையில், ARB டோக்கனின் விலை 4.5% சரிந்து வீழ்ச்சியை சந்தித்தது. சந்தை ஆய்வாளர்களின் கூற்றுப்படி, ARB-இன் குறுகிய கால விலை போக்கு கரடியின் ஆதிக்கத்தில் (bearish) உள்ளதுடன், வரும் நாட்களில் விலை மேலும் சரிந்து $0.141 மற்றும் $0.131 ஆகிய ஆதரவு நிலைகளை அடையக்கூடும் என்று எச்சரிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Ripple CTO Emeritus Clarifies Current Role at Ripple
summary: Ripple CTO Emeritus David Schwartz responds to question about his current role at the company.
content: Ripple CTO Emeritus David Schwartz has recently addressed questions regarding his current position and involvement with Ripple. Responding to inquiries from the community, Schwartz clarified the nature of his ongoing role at the blockchain company, providing transparency about his current responsibilities and status as a key technical figure within the organization.
content_ta: Ripple நிறுவனத்தில் தனது தற்போதைய பங்கு மற்றும் பொறுப்புகள் குறித்த கேள்விக்கு Ripple CTO Emeritus David Schwartz பதிலளித்துள்ளார். சமூக வலைத்தளங்களில் எழுந்த சந்தேகங்களுக்குப் பிறகு, நிறுவனத்துடன் அவர் கொண்டுள்ள தற்போதைய தொடர்பு மற்றும் அவரது முக்கிய தொழில்நுட்பப் பொறுப்புகள் குறித்து அவர் விளக்கம் அளித்துள்ளார்.

title: Shiba Inu (SHIB) Withdrawals on Binance Are Back
summary: Binance has restored SHIB withdrawals, but the token's chart still points to further downside.
content: Binance has successfully restored SHIB withdrawals for its users after a temporary pause. Despite this operational update allowing users to move their funds again, the cryptocurrency's market chart continues to show bearish technical indicators, suggesting that further downward price movement may still be ahead for the digital asset in the near term.
content_ta: Binance-ல் தற்காலிகமாக நிறுத்தப்பட்டிருந்த SHIB withdrawals தற்போது மீண்டும் தொடங்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இதன் மூலம் பயனர்கள் தங்கள் ஃபண்டுகளை மாற்றிக்கொள்ள முடியும் என்றாலும், இந்த கிரிப்டோகரன்சியின் மார்க்கெட் சார்ட் தொடர்ந்து வீழ்ச்சியைக் குறிக்கும் வகையில் உள்ளது. இதனால் இதன் விலை மேலும் குறையக்கூடும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: XRP Defies Bear Market: New Wallets Double Despite Price Pressure
summary: Instead of selling, XRP investors opened nearly 8,000 new wallets in 24 hours after the Binance hack.
content: Despite ongoing price pressure and a recent Binance hack, XRP investors have shown resilience. Instead of selling off their holdings, market participants created nearly 8,000 new XRP wallets within a 24-hour period. This unexpected growth highlights continued interest and confidence among holders during a challenging market phase.
content_ta: தற்போதைய விலை வீழ்ச்சி மற்றும் சமீபத்திய Binance ஹேக்கிங் தாக்குதல் இருந்தபோதிலும், XRP முதலீட்டாளர்கள் உறுதியைக் காட்டியுள்ளனர். தங்கள் பங்குகளை விற்பனை செய்வதற்குப் பதிலாக, 24 மணி நேரத்திற்குள் சுமார் 8,000 புதிய XRP வாலெட்களை சந்தை பங்கேற்பாளர்கள் உருவாக்கினர். இந்த எதிர்பாராத வளர்ச்சி சவாலான சந்தைக் காலத்தில் முதலீட்டாளர்களின் தொடர்ச்சியான ஆர்வத்தையும் நம்பிக்கையையும் எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

title: Is BlackRock Selling Bitcoin? What's Really Behind the $405 Million IBIT Outflow

title: Tom Lee Sees a Bull Market in the Binance Hack. Stablecoin Data Disagrees
summary:

Against Bitcoin (BTC), ETH has held

title: Vitalik Buterin Opens Devcon 8 in Costume, Warns AI Could Crack Crypto

content: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin opened Devcon 8 in Mumbai with a theatrical costume and a serious warning. He cautioned that artificial intelligence could potentially find technological shortcuts to break the underlying cryptography that secures major cryptocurrencies like Ethereum and Bitcoin. The developer conference brings together industry participants to discuss blockchain advancement, security challenges, and the future of decentralized digital assets.

title: Reverse game theory aims to align AI agents with human values
summary:
Reverse game theory's use in AI alignment could redefine regulatory frameworks, emphasizing incentive structures over interpretability.
The post Reverse game theory aims to align AI agents with human values appeared first on Crypto Briefing.

title: Ebury partners with Form3 to deliver instant payments in Canada via RTR
summary:
Ebury, the global financial services firm, is partnering with Form3, a leading global fintech offering account-to-account payments technology, to deliver instant payments in Canada via the country’s new Real Time Rail (RTR). 
The partnership expands the existing relationship between the two companies, with Form3 already providing Ebury with connectivity to the UK’s Faster Payment Service (FPS) and Europe’s SEPA payment schemes, through its best-in-class cloud native platform. 
Under this partnership, Form3 will enable Ebury to connect to Canada’s RTR , delivering instant payments and frictionless cross-border transaction capabilities to its corporate clients.  Canada’s RTR, which is undergoing a phased rollout, is a new real time payment system supporting exchange, clearing and settlement. 
The initial launch of the rail is taking place in Q4 2026, with additional participants able to join in phases throughout 2027. Ebury will leverage Form3’s platform to be among the pioneering institutions joining across the successive stages in 2027.
Form3 enables banks and fintechs to connect to payment rails in North America, the UK and Europe through just one platform, providing the financial fabric that institutions need to keep up with customer demand for global instant payments. It processes 5 billion transactions annually for over 40 global customers including J.P. Morgan, Barclays, Santander, and Klarna.
Mike Walters, CEO and co-founder of Form3 commented: “We are thrilled to be supporting Ebury to deliver instant payments in Canada. The new real time rail marks Canada’s move into instant payments, but it has somewhat of a late-mover advantage, having modelled its rail on both the UK and US’ offerings. As a result, banks and fintechs are looking for partners with a strong track record in these regions to support them to deliver instant payments in Canada and we are pleased to be bringing our experience to bear.” 
Mike Malak, Country Manager at Ebury Canada commented: “Our existing success in the UK and Europe with Form3 made them a natural partner for instant payments in Canada.  As we continue to expand our offering, simplicity, speed and minimising disruptions to our customers remain the top priorities. With Form3’s cloud native platform, we are able to add a new rail and ensure regulatory compliance with ease.  We look forward to being able to offer instant payments in Canada to all of our customers as we empower them to unlock their global ambitions.”

title: 10x Banking and ezbob Partner to Accelerate SME Lending Launches for Banks
summary:
10x Banking, the 4th-generation core banking platform powering some of the world’s largest financial institutions including Westpac and Chase UK, today announces a partnership with ezbob, a lending technology company who has worked with the likes of NatWest and Metro Bank. The partnership brings together ezbob’s lending-orchestration platform with 10x’s modular core and ledger to enable banks to launch SME lending products in weeks rather than months, and with less risk. 
SMEs are the backbone of the UK economy, accounting for 99.9% of all private businesses, yet SME lending remains one of the most persistent digital experience gaps in UK financial services. Incumbent banks have fully digitalised and automated simpler retail journeys such as current account onboarding and smaller personal loans, but SME lending is materially more complex. Attempts to close that gap have stalled because systems built on workflow tools or legacy cores move a process through internal steps without creating a connected customer journey, and become costly to operate. 
The new partnership sees ezbob provide the end-to-end lending solution, orchestrating onboarding, application, credit decisioning and AI agents. 10x provides the modular core and ledger capabilities needed to define and operate the lending product and maintain an accurate financial system of record. Open integration allows specialist components to be connected without forcing a bank into a single closed suite, and shared components can be reused to add further lending products rather than building a new silo each time. Overall, this will give banks the ability to launch new SME lending products in weeks rather than months, significantly reducing go-to-market and time-to-value. 
ezbob brings substantial experience in the segment. Lending products built on its platform have gone live in as little as six weeks, enabling 90%+ of applicants to complete an application in under five minutes and automating 94% of approvals. This, combined with the reusability of existing components and an AI-first deployment methodology, has enabled banks and financial institutions to further reduce time-to-market when launching subsequent products on the platform. 
The partnership starts in the UK, and in SME lending, where there is a wide digital experience gap. The companies intend this as the first step in a global partnership, extending to further markets and lending lines over time. 
Okan Ozaltin, Chief Product & Technology Officer, 10x Banking, said: “Banks are too often asked to choose between a broad suite that is difficult to adapt and a collection of point solutions that never quite connect. Neither gets a lender to market quickly. Bringing our core and ledger together with a specialist origination platform gives them a faster, lower-risk route to market, and the flexibility to keep evolving itafterwards. SME lending is where customers can get the most value, which is why we are starting there.” 
Yaron Shoshani, Chief Technology Officer, ezbob, said: “We built ezbob to digitise the lending journey itself, rather than automate an internal process on top of systems that were never designed for it. Pairing that with a tier-one bank-grade core means a lender can launch a complete SME product, automate decisions where policy allows, and reuse the same components to add further lending products instead of building a new silo each time.”

Initially focusing on the UK market, the partnership aims to bridge the digital experience gap in SME lending, enabling financial institutions to deploy new products in weeks rather than months.

title: Trust Payments Launches Virtual Cards for Travel Businesses, Powered by Weavr
summary:
Trust Payments, a leading fintech innovator across the UK and EU, has launched Virtual Cards for travel businesses, powered by embedded finance provider Weavr, helping eligible travel companies manage supplier payments with greater visibility and control. 
Trust Payments already supports travel businesses in accepting payments from their customers. Virtual Cards extend that relationship to the other side of the payment journey, enabling businesses to pay approved travel suppliers that accept Visa using single-use Visa virtual cards in GBP and EUR. The type of card offered will be Visa Commercial Choice Travel (VCCT), a virtual card solution purpose-built for commercial entities to handle automated supplier settlements and secure business travel payments.  
Each Virtual Card is linked to an individual booking, connecting booking and payment data so transactions are easier for finance teams to identify, track and reconcile. Businesses fund their account by bank transfer, with spending made from the available balance. 
Supplier failure remains a particular risk for the travel sector, but chargebacks can make a real difference: close to US$60 million has been recovered across 14 airline failures since 2017, according to 2025 industry research Protecting Travel Intermediaries. Though recovery isn’t guaranteed, booking data associated with each Virtual Card can help support chargeback claims if a supplier fails to deliver, subject to card scheme rules. Single-use card details cannot be reused, and payments are monitored in real time to help reduce fraud risk. 
Eligible supplier payments can also earn rebates paid by Trust Payments, helping travel businesses get more value from outgoing payments alongside faster and simpler reconciliation. Rebate rates vary depending on card and supplier type. 
Virtual Cards are available to eligible travel businesses in the UK and EEA, subject to business verification and anti-money laundering checks. 
Laurence Booth, Group CEO of Trust Payments, said: “Travel businesses have to manage money moving in both directions. We already support our customers in accepting payments from travellers and Virtual Cards mean we can now help them manage supplier payments too. By linking each supplier payment to an individual booking, we can give travel businesses clearer oversight of outgoing spend and reduce the manual work involved in reconciliation. Working with Weavr enables us to extend the payments relationship we already have with travel customers and support more of their payment journey.” 
Alex Mifsud, CEO and Co-Founder of Weavr, said: “Merchant acquirers already sit at the heart of the payments relationship with travel businesses. Embedded virtual card issuing gives them an opportunity to complement acquiring with supplier payments without having to build that capability from the ground up. By working with Trust Payments, we can bring these capabilities to travel businesses through a provider they already know, helping them gain greater visibility and control over how they pay suppliers.”

content_ta: பில்லியன்கணக்கான டாலர்கள் மதிப்பிலான வரலாற்றுச் சிறப்புமிக்க திருட்டுச் சம்பவத்தைத் தொடர்ந்து, செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு (AI) மூலம் மேலும் சைபர் தாக்குதல்கள் நிகழலாம் என்று Binance நிறுவனத்தின் நிறுவனர் CZ எச்சரித்துள்ளார். திருடப்பட்ட நிதியை வெளுக்க AI முகவர்கள் பயன்படுத்தப்படவில்லை என்று புலனாய்வாளர்கள் கண்டறிந்தாலும், சிக்கலான பாதுகாப்பு மீறல்களுக்கான தொழில்நுட்பத் தடையை தானியங்கு கருவிகள் கணிசமாகக் குறைக்கின்றன என்று அவர் வலியுறுத்தினார்.

title: Zepz names Steven Eisenhauer chief risk and compliance officer
summary:
Zepz, the global payments group behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, today announced the appointment of Steven Eisenhauer as its new Chief Risk & Compliance Officer (CRCO).
Steven Eisenhauer joins Zepz this month and will lead the group’s global risk and compliance strategy, building on the compliance expertise already in the business. Steven will oversee Zepz’s continued steadfast investment into the latest fraud and financial crime protection technology, supported by a highly skilled team. He will work closely with regulators and partners to support the development of new products as the organisation continues to grow in an evolving regulatory landscape. 
Steven joins Zepz with more than 15 years of international risk and compliance leadership across banking, payments and cryptoassets. Most recently, he served as Group Chief Risk and Compliance Officer at EML Payments, leading its global risk and compliance strategy. Before that, he built and scaled the compliance function at Ramp Network, a fast-growing crypto business. His career spans the UK, EU, US and Latin America, where he has guided fintech companies through complex regulatory environments, supported expansion into new products and markets, and built constructive relationships with regulators and financial institutions. 
Barrie Morris, Interim CEO of Zepz, said:“I’m thrilled to welcome Steven to Zepz. Strong risk management and compliance have always been fundamental to earning our customers’ trust. Steven has led this work globally across banking, payments and digital assets, and he joins a highly capable team. Compliance is embedded in our culture, with every colleague sharing responsibility for protecting the families we serve. Steven will help us build on that solid foundation. His appointment reflects how central the function is to our business and to the millions of people who rely on us.” 
Steven Eisenhauer, Chief Risk & Compliance Officer at Zepz, said: “Zepz ambition to expand financial opportunity is rooted in genuine care for its customers and the communities who depend on them. I’m excited to join a business where that responsibility gives compliance such a clear purpose. For me, this is an opportunity to build upon and strengthen our risk and compliance capabilities alongside colleagues, regulators and partners, helping Zepz grow and innovate while protecting the people who trust us with their money.” 
The appointment builds on Zepz’s strong business momentum. Revenue and send volumes grew by 25% in 2025, with the company transferring $17 billion for customers.

title: Merchant of Record vs. PayFac vs. White Label: Choosing a Model for Your Platform
summary:
It's a board meeting, and someone has a slide up. Your merchants process €400 million a year through your platform, and every euro of it earns a fee for a payment provider that isn't you. The room goes quiet, then someone says 'PayFac'. Six months later, the same company is hiring a risk team, arguing with its sponsoring bank about reserves, and absorbing €80,000 in chargebacks from a sub-merchant it onboarded in four minutes.
The opportunity on that slide was real, but the model choice was the mistake.
A platform can handle payments in three ways: use a merchant of record (MoR), become a payment facilitator (PayFac), or run a white label payment solution. On a slide, all three read as 'we handle payments'. In practice, they put different names on the transaction and different bills on your desk.
The quickest way to tell them apart is to ask whose name is on the transaction, and who pays when it goes wrong. Tax, chargebacks, margin, speed, and control all follow from the answers. Below I go through what each model involves, where they differ, and how I'd pick the one that fits your platform now without locking you out of the next one.
What is a merchant of record?
A merchant of record is the legal seller of the product. Its name appears on the customer's card statement. It collects and remits sales tax or VAT, handles refunds, fights chargebacks, and answers to the card schemes.
When you use a third-party merchant of record, it formally buys your product and resells it to your customer. You get the revenue, minus a fee. It takes the liability, the tax registrations, and the paperwork in every country you sell into. In effect, you're paying someone else to be the party that customers, tax authorities, and card schemes call.
Tax is usually what makes that worth it. Under EU VAT rules, digital services sold to consumers are taxed in the customer's country, not the seller's. A subscription sold to someone in Lisbon carries Portuguese VAT; one sold in Warsaw carries Polish VAT. Add every non-EU country with its own regime, and a software company selling subscriptions in 60 countries suddenly needs a tax department it never planned for.
The cost comes every month, as a share of revenue. The fee grows with your sales, and because the MoR's name is on the statement, its rules shape your checkout, your refund policy, and part of your customer relationship.
It's also a model for selling your own product. If your users sell their products through you, a merchant of record doesn't answer your question.
What a payment facilitator signs up for
A payment facilitator lets other businesses accept payments under its own master account with a sponsoring acquirer.
Under the Visa Rules, a PayFac contracts with an acquirer, deposits transactions, and receives settlement on behalf of its sponsored merchants. In practice, you take over the acquirer's job for your own user base: underwriting, KYC, transaction monitoring, funds flow, and payouts.
The appeal is easy to see:
Onboarding goes from weeks to minutes, because you approve the merchant instead of sending them to a bank.
You earn the spread between what you charge and what you pay.
Payments move from the cost column to the revenue column, which is why that slide gets made in the first place.
What the slide tends to leave out is that liability moves with the money. When a sub-merchant disappears with unpaid chargebacks, the acquirer doesn't chase the sub-merchant. It chases you. You need people reading risk alerts every day, a compliance stack to match, and most likely a reserve you'd rather be spending on product.
The model also has a built-in ceiling. Under Visa's rules, once a sponsored merchant passes $1 million in annual Visa volume, it has to sign directly with the acquirer. The PayFac model was built for the long tail, and your biggest customers will eventually outgrow it and take that margin with them.
White label: someone else's infrastructure, your brand
White label is the commercial shortcut. You take a provider's payment infrastructure, put your brand on it, and offer it to your users as your own product.
The provider keeps the licenses, the contracts with acquiring banks, and most of the risk. You keep the interface, the relationship with your merchants, and a revenue share.
Often, a PayFac sits behind it, which the industry sells as PayFac-as-a-service. It's how most platforms start offering embedded payments, because it gets you live in weeks rather than the months a full PayFac registration takes.
The trade-offs are predictable. Margins are thinner because the provider carries the risk and charges for it. Its onboarding rules, risk appetite, and list of supported markets become yours. And when it declines one of your merchants, you're the one explaining why, with your logo on the screen. None of that is a reason to avoid white label, but it is a reason to know exactly what you're renting.
Merchant of record vs payment facilitator: not competing models
Merchant of record and payment facilitator usually get compared side by side, as if they were two versions of the same thing. They're closer to opposites.

A merchant of record is the seller; a PayFac enables other sellers. One takes liability off your hands in exchange for a fee. The other puts liability on you in exchange for revenue and control. White label sits in between: some of the revenue, some of the control, and most of the risk still with someone else.
How I'd choose
Five questions, in this order:
Who's selling: you or your users? If you sell your own software, content, or digital goods, a merchant of record is the natural starting point, and the PayFac debate mostly doesn't apply. If your users sell through you, you're choosing between PayFac and white label.
Who would handle tax in 30 countries? If the honest answer is a nervous look at your finance lead, the MoR fee is cheaper than the alternative.
Are payments a revenue line or a feature? For vertical SaaS with thousands of small merchants, payments margin can rival subscription revenue, and that's the case for PayFac. If payments simply complete the product, a white-label payment gateway gives you most of the benefit for a fraction of the risk.
Who would run the risk operation? Our research found that nearly 60% of companies still manage payments as general admin or a secondary responsibility. Under a white-label partner, that works fine. As a PayFac, it becomes a number somebody has to explain to the acquirer.
How fast do you need to be live? White label can launch this quarter. Becoming a PayFac means sponsorship, scheme registration, compliance, and the build itself, which adds up to many months and real capital.
The pattern I see most often from platforms that get this right: start with white label, prove that merchants adopt payments, then move to PayFac once the volume justifies carrying the liability. The ones that get it wrong skip straight to PayFac because the spreadsheet looked brilliant in year one.
Switching, the part nobody plans for
Whichever model you pick, it won't be your last. A merchant of record that was ideal at $5 million in revenue starts to look expensive at $50 million. The white-label partner that got you to launch can end up blocking your next region. A PayFac built for small merchants starts losing its largest ones to direct contracts.
The platforms that move between models without pain share one thing: they kept their payment layer portable from day one. Their flows aren't hard-coded to a single provider; they own their transaction data, and they can add or swap acquirers without rebuilding checkout.
That portability is what a payment orchestration layer provides. The commercial model can change while the technical foundation stays the same.
Pick the model that fits the company you are today. Just make sure that changing it later means renegotiating a contract, not starting a replatforming project.
